title: Cobble bois
body:
Our modpack is designed to create a balanced multiplayer experience that combines exploration, engineering, creativity, and RPG-style progression into one connected world. At the center of the pack is Minecraft with major additions from mods like Cobblemon, Create, Macaw's Mods, and Tectonic. Together, these mods transform the game into a world that feels more alive, immersive, and cooperative for a group of friends playing together.

Cobblemon introduces creature collecting, battling, and adventure mechanics inspired by Pokémon while still fitting naturally into Minecraft’s survival gameplay. This gives players long-term goals through exploration, training teams, and discovering rare spawns across the world. Tectonic completely reshapes terrain generation with massive mountain ranges, deep valleys, improved rivers, and more realistic landscapes, making exploration feel rewarding and cinematic. The terrain also creates opportunities for creative base building and large-scale infrastructure projects.

The Create mod adds complex machinery, automation systems, transportation networks, and engineering mechanics that encourage experimentation and teamwork. Players can construct factories, railways, farms, and mechanical contraptions using moving parts and rotational power rather than simple automation. Alongside this, Macaw’s building mods greatly expand decorative options with new furniture, windows, roofs, bridges, doors, and structural pieces that allow every base or town to feel unique and detailed.

Additional RPG elements throughout the modpack add progression systems, combat improvements, quests, dungeons, loot, and character specialization. Instead of focusing on only one playstyle, the modpack supports explorers, builders, engineers, collectors, and fighters equally. The overall goal is to create a long-term multiplayer experience where friends can adventure together, build large communities, automate industries, battle powerful creatures, and continuously discover new things within an evolving world.
